description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to land parcel in Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District and other land parcel
reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and land acquisition matters.
